dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: Yes, my sister and I are merchants from Fontaine. We're hoping to make some investments in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: She left me on my own and headed to the Masters of the Night-Wind. Apparently, she met some "Master Chicome" there and received some investment tips. She tells me she's made quite the profit.

dialogues.speaker: Citrouillard
dialogues.text: Although, I have no idea how she's done it... That priest, Kabewa, she's from the Masters of the Night-Wind too, and she says they never give out investment tips to anyone. But... as long as she's turning a profit, who am I to complain?
